title: Mochizuki Honami — Turning Cherished Pages〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Cafe

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Welcome.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello, do you happen to have a table for two available right now?

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Two? Yes, please take the table by the window over there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much.
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is this the cafe you said you really like, Mochizuki?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I discovered it just recently.
Their tea and desserts are very good.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I really recommend their apple pies.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh wow... They have all these different types of apple pies on the menu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which should I choose? They all look so good...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What if we choose two that sound best and share them?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That way, we'll both get to try two types.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks...
So, Mochizuki, is there one you recommend...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hmm...
How about this one with yogurt cream?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The sourness of the yogurt goes perfectly with the sweetness of the apples.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That does sound good.
Then, let's get a slice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay! As for the other one...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Mmm! This is so good...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, it is.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You were right, Mochizuki.
I never realized yogurt would complement an apple pie like this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And this rum raisin one is also really good.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad you like them so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we have our food, Kusanagi, once again...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right. Nice work on the reading event.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Very nice work.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Everyone enjoyed it more than I was expecting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. And I have you to thank for agreeing to help, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As challenging as trying my hand at voice acting was, I had a lot of fun... I think I sort of understand the appeal of acting now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I think the most challenging aspect of all this was...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right...
I wasn't expecting the children to be so rambunctious.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know, right?! No matter how many times we told them to stop, they'd start running around the second we had our backs turned to them...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I honestly believe we wouldn't have gotten to the story if you hadn't come up with that plan, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You also did a wonderful job of ad-libbing, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
Something sort of nice happened to me the other day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Nice?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. One of the children who participated in the reading event came up to me and said, “Hey, you're the lady who read that story to us!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that is nice...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes...
She even said, “My parents bought me that book after I asked them.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's apparently read it a number of times with her family.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What she said reminded me of...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The sense of wonder I felt hearing it at that reading event all those years ago.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I think we were able to get her to feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Aren't you glad we did our best?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes...!
